prompt.es: Un compañero propone algo dudoso. ¿Cómo lo descartas con una razón?

choices.text: It must have been the wind, because the bike is heavy.
It might have been the wind, because the bike is heavy.
It can't have been the wind, because the bike is heavy.

feedback.es: Para descartar se usa can't have + because + razón: la bici pesada explica por qué el viento no pudo moverla.

hint.es: Descartar = can't have + because + una razón.

prompt.es: Completa: «La explicación más probable es la del vecino.»

feedback.es: Entre varias opciones se usa el superlativo: the most likely.

hint.es: Entre varias opciones se usa el superlativo.

origin.text: The ___ likely explanation is the neighbour's.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Estoy de acuerdo: no pudo ser el perro.»

answer.text: I agree it can't have been the dog

feedback.es: I agree abre la frase y can't have been descarta la idea.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su función en el debate.

pairs: It could have been the neighbour.
It can't have been the wind.
The most likely explanation is Tom.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple un paso del debate: proponer, descartar, defender o comprobar.

pairs: It could have been the neighbour.
It can't have been the wind.
The most likely explanation is Tom.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué razón da Mia.

choices.text: The bike is too heavy for the wind.
The bike was locked.
The wind was not strong.

feedback.es: Mia descarta el viento con una razón: la bicicleta pesa demasiado.

origin.audio: Leo says the wind took the bike. Mia says it can't have been the wind, because the bike is heavy.

prompt.es: Completa: «Es una buena razón, pero debemos comprobarlo.»

feedback.es: Check es el verbo para proponer verificar la idea antes de aceptarla.

origin.text: That is a good reason, but we should ___ it first.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué explicación queda descartada y por qué.

choices.text: Leo, because he was at school.
A thief, because the door was locked.
The sofa, because it is too small.

feedback.es: Mia descarta al ladrón con can't have y una razón: la puerta estaba cerrada con llave.

origin.audio: Sara says: Three explanations. One, a thief took the laptop. Two, Leo borrowed it. Three, it is under the sofa. Mia says: It can't have been a thief, because the door was locked. Sara says: I agree. The most likely explanation is that Leo borrowed it.

prompt.es: Elige la explicación más razonable con estas pistas.

choices.text: The dog must have opened the window.
A small child must have come in through the window.
A tall person might have come in through the door.

feedback.es: Las huellas grandes y la ventana cerrada apuntan a una persona alta por la puerta; el perro dormía.

origin.text: The footprints are very big. The window is closed. The dog was asleep all day.

prompt.es: Completa: «No estoy de acuerdo: no puede haber sido el gato.»

feedback.es: Descartar una explicación con seguridad se hace con can't have + participio.

origin.text: I don't agree: it ___ have been the cat.

prompt.es: Escribe tu postura: descarta una explicación y defiende otra.

answer.text: It can't have been the wind, because the bike is very heavy. The most likely explanation is that Tom borrowed it, because he has a key. Let's check with him first.
accepted: It can't have been the wind, because the bike is very heavy. The most likely explanation is that Tom borrowed it, because he has a key. Let's check with him first.
The wind can't have moved it: the bike is too heavy. Tom probably borrowed it, because he has a key. Let's ask him.

feedback.es: Una postura completa descarta con can't have y una razón, defiende la explicación más probable y propone comprobarla.

origin.text: Caso: desapareció la bicicleta de Sara. Explicaciones: el viento la movió; Tom la pidió prestada; un ladrón. La bici es muy pesada y Tom tiene una llave del garaje. Descarta una, defiende otra con la razón y propón comprobar.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo de segura está la persona.

choices.text: Not sure: it is only possible.
Completely sure.
Sure that it is impossible.

feedback.es: Might have + participio señala una posibilidad, no una certeza.

origin.audio: Her phone is off. She might have run out of battery.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ojalá hubiera llevado un paraguas.»

feedback.es: El arrepentimiento pasado pide wish + had + participio: taken.

origin.text: I wish I had ___ an umbrella with me.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que descarta una idea sobre el pasado.

choices.text: You must have seen him: he was away.
You can't have seen him: he was away.
You might see him: he was away.

feedback.es: «Estaba fuera» contradice la idea de haberlo visto: can't have + participio.

origin.text: Dices que viste a Leo en el parque, pero Leo estaba de viaje.
